How much does it cost to install carpet in Woodinville, WA?

Plan on $4 to $7 per square foot installed once carpet, pad, labor, tack strip and haul-away are totaled. Most Woodinville projects land between $2,000 and $4,500, while a 1,200 sq ft main level plus a staircase usually comes to $5,500–$8,500. The grade of carpet swings the total more than any other choice — and you make that choice with the samples lying on your own floor.
Will the mobile carpet showroom come out to Woodinville?

Yes — Woodinville is home turf, from the Sammamish Valley floor up to Hollywood Hill and English Hill. The van shows up with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades, we lay them in the rooms being carpeted so colors read true in your own light, measure every room and stair, and hand you a written price before we leave. The visit is free.
What do you charge to stretch carpet in Woodinville?

Carpet stretching in Woodinville starts at $99 per room. A power stretcher pulls wrinkles, waves and curled trip spots flat again for roughly a fifth of what new carpet would run. When the pile still stands and the color still suits the house, stretching is almost always the better spend.
What does it cost to carpet stairs in a Woodinville home?

Stair work starts at $18 per step, installed waterfall or cap-and-band. The two-story plans common on English Hill and Hollywood Hill usually add a landing or a set of pie-shaped winders — we count those in the written quote at the measure, so no extra line appears later.
How long does a Woodinville carpet install take?

One day handles most Woodinville houses. Three or four rooms plus a staircase fits comfortably between morning and dinner; a whole house with stairs and a lot of furniture can stretch into day two. The timeline is written on your quote, so you'll know before installation starts.
Do you move furniture, or do we clear the rooms first?

We move it. Beds, dressers, sofas and tables go out and come back to their exact spots on most jobs. Your part is the small stuff — closet floors, electronics, the wine rack, breakables and anything you'd rather carry yourself. Ask at the measure and we'll plan the sequence room by room.
Is it smarter to restretch our carpet or replace it?

Restretch when the pile stands back up, the backing is sound and you still like the color — a $99-per-room fix instead of a full tear-out. Replace when traffic lanes stay crushed flat, seams are separating, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has survived professional cleaning. We inspect first and tell you which side of that line you're on before any quote.
Which Woodinville neighborhoods and nearby areas do you cover?

All of Woodinville — Hollywood Hill, English Hill, Wellington, West Wellington, Leota, the Wedge, Town Center, the Hollywood District and the Sammamish Valley — plus Cottage Lake, Bear Creek, Maltby, Kingsgate, Norway Hill, North Creek and Clearview just outside the city limits. Anywhere on the Northshore is an easy trip for the van.
What's the best carpet for a house with pets?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing over a moisture-barrier pad. The barrier stops accidents from reaching the subfloor — the source of odor that never leaves — and solution-dyed fiber shrugs off strong cleaners, including diluted bleach, without losing its color. The barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot and is worth it in any home with animals.
What kind of warranty comes with the work?

OC Flooring backs every installation with a 1-year workmanship warranty, and the carpet carries its manufacturer's mill warranty on top — typically 10 to 25 years against wear and stains depending on grade. Both go on your quote in writing. Note that some mill warranties require a minimum pad grade, which is one more reason all three grades come along on the measure visit.
